box.highlights: Ward Melville 21, Sachem North 14: Hudson Philbrick went 12-for-18 for 145 yards and one touchdown to lead Ward Melville in the Suffolk I opener. Joe Karpowicz had an interception and 16 yard touchdown reception. Joe Benedetto added 101 yards rushing, on 18 carries, including one for a touchdown.

Ward Melville 24, Sachem East 7: Joe Karpowicz caught a 20-yard touchdown pass and had two interceptions to lead host Ward Melville (2-0) in Suffolk I. Matt Hubbard added a interception and Joe Massaro had a strip sack. Joe Benedetto ran 27 times for 160 yards and two touchdowns. Hudson Philbrick threw two touchdown passes, including a 30-yard TD to Jesse Spronck. AJ Vurchio had an 18-yard rushing score for Sachem East (1-1).

Ward Melville 8, Connetquot 0: Tyler Blasco caught a seven-yard touchdown late in the fourth quarter to lead host Ward Melville (3-0) in Suffolk I. Joe Karpowicz made his fourth interception on the season on Connetquot's final drive. Connetquot is 2-1.

Ward Melville 28, Whitman 14: Joe Karpowicz threw a touchdown pass, caught an 88-yard TD and ran for a score to lead visiting Ward Melville (4-0) in Suffolk I. Hudson Philbrick threw two touchdown passes and Joe Massaro and Angelo Sorbera each had a TD reception. Ward Melville shut Whitman out in the second half. Jack David caught a 30-yard score for Dylan Kollmer and Ryan Downes added a TD run for Whitman (2-2).

Ward Melville 48, Riverhead 7: Hudson Philbrick completed four of his five passes for 108 yards and two touchdowns for Ward Melville (6-0). JJ Alcindor ran five times for 95 yards and two scores, one for 34 yards and then one for 35. Jaylen Thomas rushed five times for 85 yards. Joe Benedetto had seven carries for 41 yards and two TDs. Joe Massaro began the game with a 65-yard kickoff return for a touchdown. Karter Doyle threw a 45-yard scoring pass to Kevin Qualey for Riverhead (1-5).

Longwood 35, Ward Melville 7: Ryan Mandaro and Madison Murrell each had two rushing touchdowns to lead host Longwood (6-1) in Suffolk I. Kaden Reid had two interceptions, Mike Warren had two tackles for loss, and Eddie Wesche and Murrell each had five tackles. Mandaro completed six-of-seven passes for 95 yards and one touchdown.

Ward Melville 41, Bay Shore 7: Joey Benedetto rushed for 251 yards and three touchdowns on 17 carries to lead host Ward Melville in Suffolk I. Benedetto had touchdown runs of 28, 97 and 5 yards. Ward Melville (7-1) rushed for 369 yards on 31 carries, averaging 11.9 yards per attempt. Hudson Philbrick threw for two touchdowns, a 29-yard pass to Jesse Spronck and a 24-yard toss to Logan Seta. JJ Alcindor had five carries for 86 yards and a touchdown. Joey Karpowicz had three interceptions. Xavier Hector threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Nehemiah Wilkinson for Bay Shore (4-4).

Ward Melville 21, Lindenhurst 20: Joey Karpowicz had the winning two-point conversion run in overtime to lead No. 3 Ward Melville over No. 6 Lindenhurst. Joey Benedetto had a 2-yard touchdown run before Karpowicz's two-point rush. Benedetto had 23 carries for 92 yards and a touchdown. Karpowicz had a 1-yard touchdown run in the second quarter and averaged 25 yards on three punt returns, including a 38-yard second-quarter return that led to a 17-yard touchdown pass from Hudson Philbrick to Angelo Sorbera. Philbrick completed 9 of 18 passes for 105 yards and a touchdown. Ward Melville (8-1) will play at No. 2 Longwood in the county semifinals at 6 p.m. Friday. Lindenhurst (5-4) scored 20 unanswered points before Ward Melville's overtime scores, climbing back from a 13-0 halftime deficit. Reece Wrightington had a 35-yard touchdown run and threw for two touchdowns, including a 29-yard pass to Martin Pusey in the third quarter and an 8-yard pass to Ryan Murgatroyd in overtime.

Ward Melville 14, Longwood 7: Joe Benedetto had 186 rushing yards and a touchdown to lead visiting No. 3 Ward Melville over No. 2 Longwood in the Suffolk I semifinals on Friday night. Sophomore Joe Karpowicz scored a two-yard rushing touchdown and sealed the game with his eighth interception of the season, on Longwood's final drive. Jesse Spronck had 66 rushing yards on two carries. Ward Melville (10-1) will face No. 1 Floyd at 7 p.m. on Saturday at Stony Brook University in the championship. Kalen Percer scored a 24-yard rushing touchdown for Longwood (9-2).

Floyd 34, Ward Melville 6: Ja'Quan Thomas rushed for 261 yards and five touchdowns on 30 carries to lead Floyd to its second straight Division I title and 15th overall. Jake Rivera had nine tackles and a sack, and Aaron Fisher had eight tackles for Floyd (10-1). Ward Melville finished at 9-2.
